audit.summary: All 56 segments survive. The five linked parts preserve the source's joint obligations and unrestricted component-URN scope. No new waiver or application-specific obligation appears; source regex/name inconsistencies remain explicit rather than being silently repaired.

parts.risk: The six-part shape and segment vocabulary are clear, but the canonical regex is referenced without being reproduced in the scored fields. The train-infrastructure and wagon-entrypoint special values are also placed under prefer; although 'always assembly' and the verifier details preserve them, a weak agent may underweight them as optional.

The then clause says camelCase is allowed while also requiring every name facet to be kebab-lower or CamelCase. Without the verifier regexes and source-conflict note, lower-camelCase compliance is ambiguous. This ambiguity is inherited from the source rather than introduced by the split.
Low: case-sensitive comparison, exact storage and reuse, and the anti-pattern of re-casing an existing URN are explicit.
Low: the general extension ban, named examples, counterexample, and conditional lang-* replacement are clear. Correct facet construction depends on the linked pattern and casing parts.

The required utility, argument order, and prohibition on hand construction are clear. The scored fields do not explain how an agent should establish builder provenance for an already-existing reused literal, though the obligation itself is unambiguous.

review.summary: Independent tracing found no dropped or shared segments and no net loss or added obligation. S009, the auditor's only non-PRESERVED entry (COMPRESSED_OK), is adequately distributed across the pattern, casing, case-exact, and builder rationales. All examples, special values, regexes, extension rules, and case policy survive. The five parts have distinct obligations and activations, and the strongly connected requires structure prevents satisfying one part as a substitute for the source's joint mandate. All three original edges are sensibly remapped through pattern, whose requires edges deliver the complete set, and aliasOf resolves to all five parts. Usability caveats concern the placement of special values and an inherited casing contradiction, not missing content.
